attribution: V E, S., Shin, C., & Cho, Y. (2021). Steel Industry Energy Consumption. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
scope: This is a cited projection of publisher metadata plus explicitly marked prototype interpretation limits; it is not a new source file.

Usage_kWh.prototype_sum: exact original decimal lexemes, two-decimal output

NSM.prototype_check: compare to recorded clock label without assigning an interval or timezone

WeekStatus.prototype_comparison: calendar weekday of source label only; raw text is not silently encoded to 0/1

Load_Type.causal_meaning: No equipment fault or production rate is established

source_label_convention: Keep original labels and file order; 00:00 after 23:45 is not repaired into another day.
